usedFor: Locate2u holds trips, stops and shipments, and Dropbox saves a file from a web link through “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “Shipment Status Change” in Locate2u, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A status change marks progress on a delivery, and the action files a document for it in Dropbox.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public web link to the file, so have one ready each time.
